accessLog.title: Accounting of disclosures
accessLog.subtitle: Look up who has read a subject's protected data, when, which action, and whether any sensitive value was actually revealed. Metadata only — the data itself is never recorded here.
accessLog.coverageTitle: An empty result does not mean no one accessed this subject
accessLog.coverageBody: Read-access logging is opt-in and off by default. When it is not enabled for a context or record type, reads of that data are not recorded, so an empty or short result does not by itself prove that no one accessed this subject. This view shows the raw record of every logged read; your compliance team determines which reads are accountable disclosures under HIPAA §164.528 — treatment, payment, and operations reads are generally exempt.
accessLog.timeRangeInvalid: Start time must be before end time.
accessLog.resultSummary: {count, plural, =0 {No recorded reads} one {# recorded read} other {# recorded reads}} loaded for {subject}.
accessLog.loadError: Could not query the read-access log. {message}
accessLog.idle: Choose a context and enter a subject, then Fetch to see that subject's read-access history.
accessLog.empty: No recorded disclosures for {subject} in the selected range.
accessLog.emptyHint: If you expected results, confirm that read-access logging is enabled for this context and the relevant record types — it is off by default. When logging is disabled, disclosures are not recorded and cannot appear here.
